_about: Every text the game shows, in English. Names in braces with a capital are buttons ({Action}); in small letters, they are filled in by the game ({kcal}). See the README's Text section.

things._about: The things he can gather, make and carry: their names, and what he says about them.

gather_text.Salt: A lump of salt for the sack!
gather_text.Wood: A good dry branch for the sack!

eat_text.Fish: Raw fish? Blergh! The fire by the pond grills it.
eat_text.Meat: Raw meat? No! The fire by the pond roasts it.
eat_text.Pebble: I can't eat a pebble! Hold {Grab} to throw one.
eat_text.Wheat: I can't eat raw wheat! The mill makes flour of it.
eat_text.Egg: A raw egg? Yuck! The fire by the pond fries it.
eat_text.Flour: Dry flour? Blergh! It wants baking.
eat_text.Fried_Egg: A fried egg! Sunny side up!
eat_text.Butter: A whole pat of butter! Slurp!
eat_text.Wood: I can't eat wood! It is for fires, and for building.
eat_text.Fence: No room for a fence here!
eat_text.Scarecrow: No room for a scarecrow here!
eat_text.Rod: My fishing rod! {Grab} at the pond casts it.
eat_text.Spear: My spear! Hold {Grab} to throw it.
eat_text.Gate: A gate! {Eat} puts it up in a fence.
eat_text.Campfire: My campfire kit! {Eat} sets it up.

plan_about._about: What each thing built is for, as the workbench's menu says it.
plan_about.Fence: {Eat} puts it up. Animals stay in... or out.
plan_about.Scarecrow: {Eat} stands it up. Crows keep off the wheat.
plan_about.Rod: {Grab} at the pond: fish from far, no fright.
plan_about.Spear: Hold {Grab}: throw it. {Action} picks it up again.
plan_about.Gate: {Eat} puts it up in a fence. {Action} opens it.
plan_about.Larder: {Eat} stands it up. Food keeps 5 times longer.
plan_about.Campfire: {Eat} sets it up: cook and chop meat anywhere.

thing_about._about: What the sack screen says of each thing in it that is not food.
thing_about.Pebble: For throwing: choose it, then hold {Grab} and let go
thing_about.Wood: For the oven, the cooking fire and the workbench
thing_about.Fence: {Eat} puts it up in front of you. {Grab} takes it down again
thing_about.Scarecrow: {Eat} stands it up. Crows keep off the wheat near it
thing_about.Rod: Choose it, then {Grab} at the pond: fish from far off
thing_about.Spear: Choose it, then hold {Grab} and let go. {Action} picks it up again
thing_about.Gate: {Eat} puts it up like a fence. {Action} opens and shuts it, even holding an animal
thing_about.Larder: {Eat} stands it up. {Action} opens it: food keeps 5 times longer in it
thing_about.Campfire: {Eat} sets it up: a fire to cook eggs, fish and meat at, and to chop meat. {Grab} packs it up again

kitchen._about: The oven, the cooking fire, the churn, the workbench and his campfire.

station_about.Oven: The better the baker, the richer the bake
station_about.Fire: The better the cook, the richer the dish
station_about.Churn: The better the dairy pig, the more butter and cheese
station_about.Bench: Wood from the forest, made into useful things.
station_about.Camp: The better the cook, the richer the dish

station_busy._about: Over a station at work; {seconds}: how long until it is done.

station_start._about: What he says as he starts something there, while it is not done, when it is, and as he takes it.
station_start.Churn: Round and round goes the churn!

station_wait.Oven: Still baking... it smells so good!

station_take.Churn: Into the sack, fresh from the churn!
station_take.Bench: Into the sack! I made that!

cook_bonus_line.text: {title}: +{percent}% kcal   (up to +{most}%, the more you make)
cook_bonus_line.about: {title}: what he is called there (cook_title); {percent}: how much richer he makes it now; {most}: the most it can be

raw_kcal.about: what went into it was worth

times.about: how many to make at once

kitchen.not_enough: Not enough in the sack for that!
kitchen.not_enough_wood: Not enough in the sack for that! (A fire needs wood: branches lie under the forest trees.)
kitchen.station_help: UP / DOWN: choose     LEFT / RIGHT: how many     {Action}: make it     {Close}: close

body._about: His body: what he needs, how he is, what is in him, and what he gets better at.

say_low._about: What he says when he starts to lack each.
say_low.Carbs: No fuel... I need bread, honey or fruit.
say_low.Protein: My muscles are wasting... I need eggs, fish or meat.
say_low.Fibre: Ooh, my tummy... I need cabbage or pumpkin.
say_low.Water: So thirsty... the pond is up the north-west path!
say_low.Vitamins: It's getting dim... I need berries or greens.
say_low.Electrolytes: Cramps... I need some rock salt.

say_empty._about: When he has run right out of it.
say_empty.Carbs: Running on fat alone! Bread, honey or fruit!
say_empty.Protein: No protein left! Eggs, fish or meat!
say_empty.Fibre: My tummy is in knots! Cabbage, quick!
say_empty.Vitamins: I can hardly see! Berries, quick!

say_high._about: When he is full of it.
say_high.Protein: Full of protein! Now to build some muscle!
say_high.Electrolytes: I'm so salty... and so thirsty!

say_over._about: When he has had too much of it.
say_over.Carbs: Hic! Too much sugar! Hic! It's turning to fat!
say_over.Protein: Too much protein! I'm stiff as a board!
say_over.Fibre: Too much fibre! Stand back, everybody!
say_over.Vitamins: So many vitamins... I'm glowing orange!

low_name._about: The same, as a word or two beside the level's bar.

need_eat._about: What to eat for more of each: shown when he lacks it.

trait_grows._about: What trains each, and what it is good for.

trait_gives.Legs: he is faster and jumps higher
trait_gives.Lungs: sprints cost less, breath comes back sooner
trait_gives.Gut: he holds his wind, and lets it go with {Gas}

row_section._about: The heading over the first row of each part of him.

outfit.outfit_help: UP/DOWN: row    LEFT/RIGHT: change    {Sack}: panel    {Bag}: close

menus._about: The menus and the bag's pages.

pixels.about: {level}: the pixel size chosen; {levels}: how many there are

controls_line.text: Move: {Move}   Bump: {Bump}   Jump: {Jump}   Sprint: {Sprint}   Grab / throw: {Grab}   Pick up / use / drink: {Action}   Sack: {Sack}   Eat: {Eat}   Sack, outfit, map: {Bag}   Menu: {Menu}
controls_line.about: Every button, at the foot of the menu.

menus.title: PROSIO
menus.subtitle: all belly, no brakes
menus.menu_help: Choose: UP / DOWN     Select: {Confirm}     Pixel size any time: 1 to 9

sack_and_food._about: What he says when he gathers, carries and eats.
sack_and_food.not_ripe: Not ripe yet... into the sack anyway.
sack_and_food.sack_empty: My sack is empty! {Action} picks food up.
sack_and_food.no_room: No room in my sack for it!
sack_and_food.cannot_make_here: I don't know how to make anything here yet!
sack_and_food.no_room_flour: No room in my sack for flour!
sack_and_food.no_wheat: The mill grinds wheat into flour. I have no wheat!
sack_and_food.hungry_eat: So hungry... {Eat}: eat from my sack!
sack_and_food.hungry_find: So hungry... I must find food!
sack_and_food.too_full: So full... no more food for now!

went_bad.text: Pee-yew! My {thing} went bad. Out it goes!
went_bad.about: {thing}: the name of what went bad (things.item_name)

body._about: What he says about how he feels.
body.black_and_blue: Ow... I'm black and blue! I must get away!
body.no_fibre: Nothing in there... I need more fibre!
body.drink_washed: Glug glug glug... that washed it out!

animals._about: What he says to and about the animals.
animals.no_room_fish: No room in my sack for more fish!
animals.fish_bite: A bite! Got one on the line!
animals.fish_no_bite: No bite... they are too far out. I'll wait.
animals.fish_missed: Splash! Missed... they come close if I stand still.
animals.crow_at_wheat: Caw, caw! A crow is at my wheat!
animals.rabbit_at_cabbages: Rustle, rustle... a rabbit is at my cabbages!
animals.chopping_block: The chopping block is by the fire, at the pond (or by my campfire).
animals.no_room_meat: No room in my sack for meat!
animals.chop: Chop, chop, chop! Meat for the fire!
animals.billy_no_milk: A billy goat gives no milk!
animals.only_bash: Nothing to do with this one but bash or throw it.
animals.goat_no_milk: This goat has no milk just now.
animals.no_room_milk: No room in my sack for more milk!
animals.milked: Squirt, squirt! A jug of milk!
animals.not_hard_enough: Not hard enough... I need more weight!

fox_ate.text: Oh no! The fox ate my {thing}!
fox_ate.about: {thing}: the name of what it ate (things.item_name)

fox_took.about: {thing}: the name of what it took

got_back.about: {thing}: the name of what he got back

handling._about: What he says as he grabs, lifts, holds, throws and bashes.
handling.too_many_in_air: Wait... too many in the air!
handling.cannot_hold: Too heavy! I can't hold on!
handling.too_tired_put_down: Too tired to throw it... down it goes.

building._about: What he says as he puts up, opens and takes down what he has built.
building.fence_way_too_heavy: Way too heavy to lift over! It needs a gate.
building.fence_too_heavy: Too heavy to lift over... I need stronger arms!
building.meadow_fence_there: The meadow has its own fence there!
building.fence_there: There is a piece of fence here already! {Grab} takes it down.
building.fence_all: That is all the fence the meadow can take!
building.in_the_way: Something is in the way here!
building.gate_up: Knock, knock! A gate. {Action} opens it.
building.first_fence: Knock, knock! My first piece of fence!
building.another_fence: Knock, knock! Another piece of fence!
building.campfire_already: My campfire is already set up! {Grab} at it packs it up.
building.campfire_no_spot: Not here: I need a clear spot for my campfire!
building.campfire_up: There! My own campfire. {Action}: cook something!
building.larders_all: That is all the larders the meadow can take!
building.scarecrows_all: That is all the scarecrows the meadow can take!
building.no_room_fence: No room in my sack for more fence!
building.fence_down: Down it comes. Into the sack!
building.larder_empty_first: I must empty the larder first!
building.no_room_larder: No room in my sack for the larder!
building.campfire_take_off_first: Take what is cooked off it first!
building.no_room_campfire: No room in my sack for the campfire!
building.campfire_down: The fire is out. Into the sack!
building.no_room_scarecrow: No room in my sack for more scarecrows!
building.rabbit_kept_out: Ha! The rabbit cannot get in!

prompts._about: The line at the bottom of the screen: what the buttons would do just now. Two things at once are kept apart by five spaces.
prompts.gate_shut_drag: {Action}: shut the gate     drag it through first!
prompts.gate_open_bring: {Action}: open the gate, to bring it through
prompts.gate_shut_take: {Action}: shut the gate     {Grab}: take it down
prompts.gate_open_take: {Action}: open the gate     {Grab}: take it down
prompts.put_down_tired: {Grab}: put it down (too tired to throw)
prompts.put_down_or_throw: {Grab}: put it down     hold {Grab}, let go: throw
prompts.too_heavy_over_fence: Too heavy to lift over the fence: it needs a gate     {Grab}: let go
prompts.too_heavy_swing: Too heavy to swing!   {Bump}: heave     {Grab}: let go
prompts.milk_goat_licking: {Action}: milk the goat while it licks
prompts.pick_branch: {Action}: pick up the branch (wood for fires and for building)
prompts.break_salt: {Action}: break off a lump of rock salt
prompts.open_larder_take: {Action}: open the larder     {Grab}: take it down
prompts.oven_take: {Action}: take it out of the oven
prompts.mill_about: The mill grinds wheat into flour
prompts.pond_cast_near: {Action}: drink     {Grab}: cast the rod, a fish is near enough!
prompts.pond_cast: {Action}: drink     {Grab}: cast the rod (no fish near enough yet)
prompts.pond_grab: {Action}: drink     {Grab}: grab for a fish (stand still and they come)
prompts.winding: Let go of {Grab}: throw     {Aim}: aim at something else
prompts.hold_throw_spear: Hold {Grab}, let go: throw the spear
prompts.hold_throw_pebble: Hold {Grab}, let go: throw a pebble
prompts.put_fence: {Eat}: put a piece of fence up here
prompts.take_fence_down: {Grab}: take this piece of fence down
prompts.jump_fence: {Jump}: jump over the fence     {Grab}: take this piece down
prompts.throw_over_fence: Throw it over the fence: hold {Grab}, let go
prompts.too_heavy_jump_fence: Too heavy to jump the fence!     {Grab}: take this piece down

chop_it.about: {then}: what letting go would do (let_go, put_down_tired or put_down_or_throw)

drag_to_fire.text: Drag it to a fire to chop it     {then}

drag_to_fire_or_bash.text: Drag it to a fire to chop it     {Bump}: bash with it     {then}

drag_to_pond.text: Drag it to the fire by the pond     {then}

drag_to_pond_or_bash.text: Drag it to the fire by the pond     {Bump}: bash with it     {then}

pick_growing.text: {Action}: pick it now ({kcal} kcal, still growing)

pick_berries_ripening.text: {Action}: pick berries now ({kcal} kcal, still ripening)

screen._about: Words on the game's screen, besides the line at the bottom.

mill_busy.about: {count}: how much wheat is left to grind

region_about._about: What is found there: shown for a few seconds as he gets there.
region_about.Forest: berries, apples, mushrooms, nuts... and foxes
region_about.Hills: rock salt, goats to milk, and the churn
region_about.Pond: water, fish, and the cooking fire

ending._about: How it ends when he has run right out of something for too long (the rest end only by fat, or by fainting).

Water.title: DRIED OUT!
Water.line: He needed a drink from the pond.

Vitamins.title: NO VITAMINS!
Vitamins.line: Everything went dark. He needed fruit and greens.

Electrolytes.title: CRAMPED UP!
Electrolytes.line: With no salt every muscle seized up.

screen.fainted_line: No fat and no carbs left... nothing to keep him going.
screen.heart_attack_line: Too heavy... his heart could not keep up.
screen.knocked_out_line: Bruised all over... the animals got the better of him.
screen.wake_up: Press {Restart} to wake up at home
screen.wake_up_note: (his sack is lost, and some of his muscle; what he has learnt stays)

kg_whole.about: his weight beside the weight bar, in whole kilograms

larder.larder_about: Food keeps five times longer in here
larder.nothing_in_either: Nothing in the sack, nothing in the larder.
larder.larder_help: UP / DOWN: choose     RIGHT: one in     LEFT: one out     {Action}: all of it     {Close}: close

sack_page._about: The sack page of the bag, and the sack box on the screen.

plus_kg.about: what eating it adds to him, to a hundredth

sack_page.sack_help: ARROWS: choose   {Action}: eat, or choose to use   {Sack}: other panel   {Bag}: close
sack_page.not_raw: Not to eat raw: the fire by the pond cooks it
sack_page.not_to_eat_wheat: Not to eat: the mill grinds it into flour
sack_page.not_to_eat_flour: Not to eat: bake it in the oven
sack_page.cooked_richer: Cooked: richer than what went in
sack_page.made_of: MADE OF, IN SHARES OF ITS KCAL:

body_page._about: The body page of the bag.

map_page._about: The map page of the bag.
map_page.map_dark: The dark parts are still to explore.

controls_page._about: The controls page of the bag, where buttons are given to actions.

controls._about: The buttons, the keys and the controls page.

pad_name._about: The controller's buttons, as the screen names them.

key_numpad.about: a key on the number pad; {n}: its number

controls.key_kept: That key is kept for moving, pausing or the pixel size.
controls.only_key: That is the only key of another action: give it another key first.
controls.pad_kept: The D-pad moves him and MENU pauses: choose another button.
controls.one_key_at_least: Every action keeps one key at least.
controls.back_to_defaults_done: Back to the buttons it started with.

text: Always: stick, D-pad, WASD or arrows move; MENU or ESC pauses;
A, ENTER or SPACE chooses. Clicking a stick to sprint keeps
him running until he stops; any other sprint button is held.

controls.press_button: Press a button on the controller   (MENU or ESC: cancel)
controls.press_key: Press a key   (BACKSPACE: none   ESC: cancel)
